concepts.name: 25-slider-classic
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design ONE premium minimal app icon for Focus Mate, a calm focus app whose sessions are bus journeys. This round is based on actual bus side-window construction observed in real product photographs: wide rounded rectangular frames, fixed/sliding glass panes, offset vertical overlap rails, and small edge-mounted latch handles. Concept: A front-on horizontal bus passenger sliding window: one wide softly rounded rectangular WHITE frame on pure BLACK, with one slim vertical divider at 57 percent of the interior width and a short thick horizontal latch tab projecting inward from the far left edge around midheight. Empty black glass openings. Width to height about 1.55:1. The three functional parts are outer frame, pane seam, one latch. No additional marks. Center one compact brand emblem with generous empty space, symbol approximately 48–54 percent of square width. BLACK AND WHITE ONLY, pure #000000 and #FFFFFF. ABSOLUTELY NO sun, circles representing celestial objects, fields, landscape, horizon lines, hills, scenery, capsule airplane portholes, arched doors or any bus vehicle body. No lettering, text, arrows, motion streaks, dots, screw heads or tiny mechanical details unless required by the explicit concept. The icon must be derived from the physical window frame and its latch, not from what is outside the window. Strictly flat vector-like finish, clean sharp edges, carefully rounded corners, even deliberate line weight, no gradients, noise, shadows, reflections, glass sheen, 3D or photorealism. Full square background, no pre-rounded exterior corners, no mockup, no grid, one icon only.
